entries.summary: Bischof Lorenz von Bibra erwirbt von Hans von Rosenberg (Rosenberg) weitere Rechte in der Stadt Lauda (Lauden) und Umgebung.
entries.german: Noch etliche gerechtikait daselbst, von Hannsen von Rosenberg erkaufft. Recepta uf der Camern, Originale in litera. R. proprietatum
entries.english: The entry says that further rights were bought there from Hans von Rosenberg and recorded in the chamber register, with the original filed under letter R, ‘properties.’ The archive summary supplies the context: the buyer was Bishop Lorenz von Bibra, and the rights were in Lauda and its surrounding district.
